correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated the even signed permutations, using sign products along signed cycles to compute fixed-space codimension and checking it against all word-metric spheres in the twelve reflections. The stipulated interval and all order comparisons give proper face counts (48,189,162); the complement reverses comparisons and the vertex periods are three and six. Orient each barycentric flag by increasing face size. Orbit identifications preserve that size and the associated barycentric coordinates, so a closed flag has no self-identification: its faces of different size sequences cannot be identified, and any action carrying a face to itself fixes that face pointwise. Thus flag orbits with face incidences give the actual geometric quotient, not a simplicial vertex quotient. The independent canonical-orbit enumeration gives (72,231,162) cells. Contracting a breadth-first spanning tree leaves 160 oriented generators; each triangle contributes its two increasing edges followed by the inverse of its long edge. Single-occurrence substitution uses the selected disk to homotope each remaining attaching loop off the deleted edge, after which that edge and disk cancel. The replay used a different tree/order and kept all empty relators: 159 substitutions leave one loop and three words with degrees (−3,0,−3). These agree up to ordering and orientation of the two-disks with the frozen words. Sliding one degree-three disk across the other makes its attachment null without deleting that disk, leaving a Moore space and two two-spheres. In particular H₁=π₁=Z/3 and H₂=Z², and there are no higher cells in the resulting model.
residual_risks: Computational certification is for the stated D₄ interval and ordinary quotient only. It is not a formal proof-assistant certificate; the homotopy reductions use elementary CW arguments.

value.rationale: This is the full homotopy type of the natural rank-reversing symmetry quotient at the smallest irreducible type D, and separates the torsion-bearing Moore part from genuinely free sphere summands. Other rank-four types and subgroup quotients can have different outcomes; an exact D₄ model is useful in comparing which features of those examples persist. Its value rests on the attaching-map classification, not merely reproducing an Euler characteristic or fixed-element count.
residual_risks: No extrapolation to higher ranks, equivariant homotopy type, or fixed-point decomposition is warranted.
